import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler,PolynomialFeatures,OneHotEncoder,SplineTransformer
from sklearn.linear_model import RidgeCV,LinearRegression, LassoCV
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.model_selection import KFold,cross_val_predict
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error,r2_score
from catboost import CatBoostRegressor
from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer
import joblib
D=pd.read_csv('/work/alloy_pair_max_train.csv')
y=D.target.values
nums=[c for c in D if c not in ['target','heat_treatment','route','Fe']]
cats=['heat_treatment','route']
X=D[nums+cats]
cv=KFold(5,shuffle=True,random_state=42)
enc=OneHotEncoder(sparse_output=False,drop='first')
Z=np.column_stack([StandardScaler().fit_transform(D[nums]),enc.fit_transform(D[cats])])
for name,F in [('linear',Z),('quadratic',PolynomialFeatures(2,include_bias=False).fit_transform(Z)),('spline3',np.column_stack([SplineTransformer(n_knots=4,degree=3).fit_transform(D[nums]),enc.transform(D[cats])])),('spline5',np.column_stack([SplineTransformer(n_knots=6,degree=3).fit_transform(D[nums]),enc.transform(D[cats])]))]:
 model=make_pipeline(StandardScaler(),RidgeCV(alphas=np.logspace(-2,4,25)))
 p=cross_val_predict(model,F,y,cv=cv)
 model.fit(F,y)
 print(name,'RMSE',mean_squared_error(y,p)**.5,'r2',r2_score(y,p),'alpha',model[-1].alpha_,flush=True)
 if name=='linear':
  print(pd.Series(model[-1].coef_/model[0].scale_,index=nums+list(enc.get_feature_names_out())).sort_values().to_string(),flush=True)
 if name=='quadratic':
  names=PolynomialFeatures(2,include_bias=False).fit(np.ones((2,Z.shape[1]))).get_feature_names_out(nums+list(enc.get_feature_names_out()))
  coef=pd.Series(model[-1].coef_/model[0].scale_,index=names)
  print(coef.sort_values().head(30).to_string(),flush=True)
  print(coef.sort_values().tail(30).to_string(),flush=True)
for depth in [3,4,5,6]:
 model=CatBoostRegressor(iterations=1500,depth=depth,learning_rate=.025,l2_leaf_reg=5,loss_function='RMSE',verbose=False,thread_count=2,cat_features=cats)

 print('catboost',depth,'RMSE',mean_squared_error(y,p)**.5,'r2',r2_score(y,p),flush=True)
 model.fit(X,y)
 joblib.dump(model,'/tmp/cat_alloy_%s.pkl'%depth)
 if depth==4:print(pd.Series(model.feature_importances_,index=X.columns).sort_values().to_string(),flush=True)

from sklearn.base import BaseEstimator,RegressorMixin
from sklearn.linear_model import HuberRegressor
cv=KFold(10,shuffle=True,random_state=73)
class Concave(BaseEstimator,RegressorMixin):
 def __init__(self,alpha=0.1,n=16):self.alpha=alpha;self.n=n
 def fit(self,X,y):
  A=np.column_stack([np.ones(len(y)),X]); self.mean_=A.mean(axis=0);self.mean_[0]=0;self.scale_=A.std(axis=0);self.scale_[0]=1
  A=(A-self.mean_)/self.scale_
  lb=np.full(A.shape[1],-np.inf); ub=np.full(A.shape[1],np.inf);ub[1+self.n:1+2*self.n]=0
  P=np.eye(A.shape[1])*np.sqrt(self.alpha);P[0,0]=0
  fit=lsq_linear(np.row_stack([A,P]),np.r_[y,np.zeros(A.shape[1])],bounds=(lb,ub),tol=1e-10,max_iter=500)
  self.coef_=fit.x/self.scale_;return self
 def predict(self,X):return (np.column_stack([np.ones(len(X)),X])-self.mean_)@self.coef_

class Concave(BaseEstimator,RegressorMixin):
 def __init__(self,alpha=0.1,n=16):self.alpha=alpha;self.n=n
 def fit(self,X,y):
  A=np.column_stack([np.ones(len(y)),X]); self.mean_=A.mean(axis=0);self.mean_[0]=0;self.scale_=A.std(axis=0);self.scale_[0]=1
  A=(A-self.mean_)/self.scale_
  lb=np.full(A.shape[1],-np.inf); ub=np.full(A.shape[1],np.inf);ub[1+self.n:1+2*self.n]=0
  P=np.eye(A.shape[1])*np.sqrt(self.alpha);P[0,0]=0
  fit=lsq_linear(np.row_stack([A,P]),np.r_[y,np.zeros(A.shape[1])],bounds=(lb,ub),tol=1e-10,max_iter=500)
  self.coef_=fit.x/self.scale_;return self
 def predict(self,X):return (np.column_stack([np.ones(len(X)),X])-self.mean_)@self.coef_
